name: Thatched Hearth-Hamlet
description: Found a close-knit hearth hamlet of roundhouses, firepits, and grain storage pits.
creativePrompt: What prompted this species to build their first permanent hearths here? Who tends the eternal fire?
exampleNarrative: A circle of thatched hearth-huts arose by the stream, smoke curling peacefully into the morning mist.

name: Timber Palisade Village
description: Erect a sturdy log palisade village with perimeter ditch and wooden watchtower.
creativePrompt: What predators or rival clans made high timber walls necessary? What is kept in the central hall?
exampleNarrative: Sharpened pine stakes enclosed the burgeoning village, providing refuge from the prowling beasts of the dark forest.

name: Crossroads Market Town
description: Establish a bustling river confluence or overland crossroads market town.
creativePrompt: What goods are traded here? Which travelers first met at this thriving crossroads?
exampleNarrative: Clay-brick storehouses and open-air barter plazas drew traders from three river valleys to the crossroads town.

name: Nomadic Felt Yurt Camp
description: Pitch a seasonal encampment of circular felt yurts following grazing herds across open plains.
creativePrompt: What seasonal celestial signs signal when the tribe must pack the yurts and move?
exampleNarrative: A sprawling ring of bleached felt tents was raised on the high steppe, horses tethered around glowing dung-fires.

name: Cliffside Canyon Pueblo
description: Carve multi-tiered stone and adobe dwellings into the alcove of a sheer canyon cliff.
creativePrompt: How do elders and children scale the cliff face? What ancient threat made this aerie necessary?
exampleNarrative: Adobe dwellings climbed the canyon wall like swallow nests, safe from flash floods and marauders below.

name: Coastal Stilt Fishing Village
description: Raise platform dwellings on ironwood stilts above tidal estuaries and mangrove bays.
creativePrompt: What sea bounties sustain the stilt-dwellers? How do they appease the spirits of the deep tide?
exampleNarrative: Rope bridges connected a thriving network of stilt platforms standing proud above the azure tide waters.

name: Frontier Stockade Outpost
description: Build a fortified wilderness outpost watching over mountain passes or river narrows.
creativePrompt: Who volunteers to garrison this lonely frontier post? What signals do they send to the homeland?
exampleNarrative: A solitary timber redoubt took watch upon the ridge, its signal braziers ready to warn the heartlands.

name: Sanctuary of the First Dawn
description: Construct a luminescent temple-city carved from living alabaster and consecrated by the sun.
creativePrompt: What miraculous celestial ward protects this glowing sanctuary from mortal harm?
exampleNarrative: Alabaster spires arose overnight, glowing with the eternal warmth of an unbroken dawn.
